interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility continental crosswalk markings at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian-actuated signals or signage to facilitate safe access to the community center.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the wide sidewalk and the curb to provide better separation from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding vegetation to provide a physical buffer between the narrow sidewalk and moving traffic while improving the streetscape.
